title: Two-sided cellular and physiological effects of zinc oxide nanoparticles (nZnO): a critical review
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EN00676C, Critical Review
Anqi Sun, Shuoli Ma, Wen-Xiong Wang
The balanced presence of zinc oxide nanoparticles (nZnO) offers essential nutritional properties, whereas an excessive amount of nZnO can trigger ecotoxicity, both at the cellular and individual levels.
